## jscpd-rs

`jscpd-rs` is a native Rust implementation of the common `jscpd`
duplicate-code detection workflow.

It is built for local development and CI/CD environments where duplicate-code
checks should be fast enough to run on every pull request. The project focuses
on practical compatibility with upstream `jscpd`, prebuilt npm binaries for
common platforms, native reports, and reproducible benchmark gates.

- Repository: <https://github.com/vv-bogdanov/jscpd-rs>
- npm: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/jscpd-rs>
- crates.io: <https://crates.io/crates/jscpd-rs>
- docs.rs: <https://docs.rs/jscpd-rs>
